period_note: Unaudited interim financial performance, Jan-Mar 2023 (Q1). Sourced from a DSE (dsebd.org) company-page table titled 'Interim Financial Performance: 2023', recovered via a Wayback Machine capture from 2023-10-28. From this capture onward (unlike the 2020/2021 captures), DSE's page no longer displays the 'Turnover/Revenue', 'Profit from continuing operations', 'Profit for the period', or 'Total Comprehensive Income' mn-figures at all (the rows are present in the page's HTML but wrapped in a comment, rendering only placeholder zeros) - only EPS and period-end market price remain visible, so this and later quarters in this dataset are thinner than 2020/2021. This is this dataset's only source for FY2023 Q1 - complements (does not overlap with) the existing 2023_Q4.json, which is capital/asset-quality data only (from a Basel III Pillar 3 disclosure) and has no P&L or EPS figures of its own. Solo-basis presumed per the same caveat as 2020_Q1.json.
